mappings.note: Translation v1 contains only the title/introductory text. The actual prayer content of OSMAIN v1 ('Herre, hvor mange...') is missing from Translation v1 and appears as Translation v2.
Translation v2 contains the first half of OSMAIN v1 ('Herre, hvor mange...'). The second half of OSMAIN v1 is missing from this translation verse.
Content matches OSMAIN v2 exactly (Mange sier om min sjel... Sela).
Content matches OSMAIN v3 exactly (Men du, Herre... løfter mitt hode).
Content matches OSMAIN v4 exactly (Høyt roper jeg... Sela).
Content matches OSMAIN v5 exactly (Jeg la meg ned... holder meg oppe).
Content matches OSMAIN v6 exactly (Jeg frykter ikke... fra alle kanter).
Content matches OSMAIN v7 exactly (Reis deg... tenner).
Content matches OSMAIN v8 exactly (Frelsen tilhører... Sela).
